noticeReproducibility.note: The verifier compares source and archive bytes exactly. A line-ending change changes the source/member SHA-256 and requires a fresh receipt; no normalization is performed.

sourceDerivedVerification.note: Archives and editable receipts were accepted only after live source re-derivation and member comparison by the trusted Ludory verifier.

canonicalRightsManifest.note: The manifest path is referenced by the migration inventory; the current game repository does not carry a matching row for the four generated portraits.

gameDistributable.reason: Resource-level legal confirmation is incomplete; mechanical package integrity is separate.

ludoryFrameworkDistribution.reason: lighthouse.svg and shoreline.svg are framework/template rights items and are not game ZIP members; framework rights remain a separate Ludory decision.

developmentOnlyDependencies.reason: Vendored Web Helper is not present in either game archive; its provenance remains a Ludory/development-only obligation.
